model_output:
```sql
WITH cassville_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Cassville'
    AND border_type = 'city'
    AND ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('omitted_large_wkt_491_chars'), 4326) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(rast_val), 2) AS mean_elevation
FROM
  public.dem_us,
  cassville_geom
WHERE
  ST_Intersects(rast, cassville_geom.geom)
  AND ST_ValueCount(rast, cassville_geom.geom, true) > 0
  AND ST_Band(rast, 1) IS NOT NULL
  AND ST_IsEmpty(rast) = false
  AND ST_Clip(rast, cassville_geom.geom, true) IS NOT NULL
  AND ST_IsEmpty(ST_Clip(rast, cassville_geom.geom, true)) = false
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    (ST_SummaryStats(ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, cassville_geom.geom, true))).mean AS rast_val
) AS stats;
```
